records.site: Regional Jet Tail 512 Hydraulic System B
records.description_body: Hydraulic System B on tail 512 showed a slow pressure decay that grounded the aircraft over a seven hour window; the discrepancy was logged at 05:50 and cleared after a seal replacement at 12:50.
records.timeline_body: A hydraulic pressure low advisory triggered at 05:41, nine minutes before the discrepancy was logged; the system was isolated and the actuator seal replaced.
records.contributing_body: Actuator-controller software B2.3 does not annunciate slow decay promptly; the actuator seal was degraded past its service life.
records.action: Upgrade to actuator-controller software B2.5 across the fleet, or shorten the seal inspection interval on B2.3.

records.site: Regional Jet Tail 519 Green Hydraulic System
records.description_body: The Green hydraulic system on tail 519 lost pressure at the main power users over a four hour window; the crew followed the hydraulic overheat checklist and returned the aircraft to service after a pump replacement.
records.timeline_body: A green-system low-pressure caution set during taxi; maintenance isolated the affected pump and confirmed 3000 psi restored after replacement.
records.contributing_body: A skewed pulley bearing installation produced abnormal loads and premature bearing failure in the affected hydraulic circuit.
records.action: Inspect pulley bearing installation torque on all Green-system aircraft and replace skewed bearings.

records.site: Regional Jet Tail 527 Yellow Hydraulic System
records.description_body: The Yellow hydraulic system on tail 527 showed fluid leaking in the nose wheel well over a three hour window; the landing gear retract actuator beam assembly showed damage.
records.timeline_body: A post-flight examination revealed hydraulic fluid leaking and damage to the lower chord of the nose landing gear retract actuator beam.
records.contributing_body: Improper maintenance of the landing gear system resulted in a hydraulic fluid leak and insufficient pressure to extend and lock the gear.
records.action: Re-inspect nose landing gear retract actuator beam assemblies fleet-wide and correct maintenance procedures.

records.site: Regional Jet Tail 533 Blue Hydraulic System
records.description_body: The Blue hydraulic system on tail 533 experienced a hand-pump shaft wear finding over a five hour inspection window; the leak was assessed as not significant enough to deplete the system.
records.timeline_body: Wear marks were identified on the hand-pump shaft during inspection but did not result in a failure of the hydraulic supply.
records.contributing_body: Hand-pump shaft wear was observed; the leak was minor and the system retained pressure, but the component was flagged for monitoring.
records.action: Add hand-pump shaft wear checks to the recurring hydraulic inspection baseline.

records.site: Regional Jet Tail 540 Green Hydraulic System
records.description_body: The Green hydraulic system on tail 540 showed reservoir level decay over a six hour window that grounded the aircraft.
records.timeline_body: A reservoir low advisory triggered during preflight; a fitting was found weeping and replaced.
records.contributing_body: A loose return-line fitting on software B2.3 allowed a slow reservoir decay.
records.action: Torque-check return-line fittings fleet-wide and upgrade to B2.5.

records.site: Regional Jet Tail 547 Yellow Hydraulic System
records.description_body: The Yellow hydraulic system on tail 547 logged a brake-accumulator precharge fault over a two hour window.
records.timeline_body: A precharge low reading was found during inspection; the accumulator was recharged to spec.
records.contributing_body: A slow nitrogen leak in the brake accumulator on software B2.4 lowered the precharge.
records.action: Add accumulator precharge checks to the transit inspection and update to B2.6.

records.site: Regional Jet Tail 553 Blue Hydraulic System
records.description_body: The Blue hydraulic system on tail 553 showed a filter bypass indication over a three hour window.
records.timeline_body: A filter differential-pressure warning set; the filter element was replaced and the indication cleared.
records.contributing_body: A clogged filter element on software B2.5 tripped the bypass indication.
records.action: Shorten the filter replacement interval and update to B2.6.
